title: Entity history row
responsibility: Shows a selectable commit row with recorded change reasons, metrics and verification.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.row
inputs.description: Required commit history row with date, subject, measured size/complexity, deltas, reviews and change classification.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.detail
inputs.description: Required loaded detail or undefined. Its explanations supply summarized reasons and attempts; subject is the fallback when behavior text is absent.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.timing
inputs.description: Required selected-profile timing or undefined. Displays before-to-after when before exists, otherwise after only; missing timing is Not measured.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.verdict
inputs.description: Required passing flag, label and optional reasons forwarded to the verification marker without reevaluation.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.selected
inputs.description: Required flag applying row selection styling and pressed state to the commit button.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.viewed
inputs.description: Required flag marking this as the currently viewed commit and adding its badge.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.to
inputs.description: Required destination for opening this entity at this row’s commit.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.nav
inputs.description: Required navigation context passed to the revision link.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.onselect
inputs.description: Required callback: commit button passes false for the summary, Full reasons passes true for original text. Does not itself navigate.

outputs.name: EntityHistoryRow
outputs.description: Table row with date, short commit, change/viewed badges, bounded reason or subject, attempts, metrics/deltas, optional budget approval, timing and verdict. Long reasons expose a Full reasons button. View revision uses the supplied destination; missing measurements remain explicit.
